integrity: The theorem and strictness example were reconstructed from explicit definitions and proof steps; no numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The result weakens the global uniform \(C_0\) hypothesis but does not remove all small-time regularity assumptions.
It does not prove necessity of periodic-set small-time control.
A cited 2026 preprint titled A noncompact Bowen-Walters inequality was not available for full-text comparison and remains a literature-overlap risk.
title: Periodic-set small-time control suffices for the noncompact Bowen–Walters bound
